---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest a new capability or improvement for MetaEcosystemSuite
title: "[FEATURE] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ""
---

## Which module does this affect?

- [ ] DSA Auditor (`dsa_auditor/`)
- [ ] Metrics Migrator (`metrics_migrator/`)
- [ ] Ad Policy Linter (`policy_linter/`)
- [ ] Status Sentinel (`status_sentinel/`)
- [ ] CLI (`cli.py`)
- [ ] New module
- [ ] Other / cross-cutting (e.g. CI, packaging, docs)

## Is your request related to a problem?

A clear description of the problem or limitation you're running into.
E.g. "Every time Meta renames a metrics field I have to manually
patch `mappings.py`..."

## Describe the solution you'd like

What you want to happen. Be as concrete as possible — for a new rule
or mapping, give the exact rule/mapping you'd add; for a CLI change,
sketch the command signature you have in mind.

## Describe alternatives you've considered

Any alternative solutions, workarounds, or existing tools you've
already tried.

## Additional context

Links to relevant Meta API docs, EU DSA guidance, or anything else
that helps scope the request.
